name: extract_stream
description: Extract a data stream from an NTFS E01 image using icat. Returns the raw bytes (base64-encoded); a failure comes back as JSON with icat's status, never as base64 error text.

inode.description: Inode or inode-attr_id to extract, e.g. 168 or 168-128-4

offset.description: Sector offset (0 for logical volume without partition table)
